title: Realignment Charge Share by CondoGuard Billing Plan
content:
Schedule of the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy: the share of the full-year realignment charge billed for the rest of the term depends on how the term is billed.

| Billing plan of the term | Installments of the current term not yet billed | Realignment share |
|---|---|---|
| monthly EFT (12 installments) | at least one | the number of the current term's monthly installments not yet billed, divided by 12 |
| two-pay (2 installments) or quarterly (4 installments) | at least one | the whole calendar months from the day the realignment takes effect to the expiration date, a part month dropped, divided by 12 |
| monthly EFT, two-pay or quarterly | none | the calendar days from the day the realignment takes effect to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term |
| annual or mortgagee escrow | any | the calendar days from the day the realignment takes effect to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term |

## Notes to the schedule

1. On a monthly EFT plan with at least one installment of the current term not yet billed, the realignment share is the number of the current term's monthly installments not yet billed divided by twelve, where the installments billed are the premium installments posted with the current term's effective date.
2. On a two-pay or quarterly plan with at least one installment of the current term not yet billed, the realignment share is the whole calendar months from the day the realignment takes effect to the expiration date, a part month dropped, divided by twelve.
3. On any other plan, or when every installment of the current term has already been billed, the realignment share is the calendar days from the day the realignment takes effect to the expiration date divided by the calendar days in the term.

## Illustrations (hypothetical terms)

- Monthly EFT, 8 installments of the current term posted: 4 not yet billed, share 4 divided by 12.
- Quarterly, installments 1 and 2 posted, realignment taking effect on 15 March with an expiration date of 1 November: whole months to the expiration date are 7, the part month dropped, share 7 divided by 12.
- Two-pay, both installments posted: the day share applies.
- A full-year realignment charge of 41.13 USD with share 4 divided by 12 gives 13.71 USD for the rest of the term.
